names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 23 Απριλίου, «Άγιος Αθανάσιος ο από μάγων», with the rank word left off; the epithet «ο από μάγων», from among the magicians, is kept in the English form because it is all that tells him from the corpus's other men of the name.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's entry for 23. април ст. ст., „главни жрец Атанасије“ — **out of the entry's body and not out of its heading**, which names the great martyr alone. The form is the nominative the entry itself prints, in a list of those who received the faith; the trade or station named beside it is left off, as is the companionship or day clause this corpus keeps in the English display name.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 23ης Απριλίου — «Άγιος Αθανάσιος ο από μάγων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **George's own page carries a different feast type**: «Ειδικός υπολογισμός. Εορτάζει στις 23 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους. Εάν όμως η εορτή πέσει πρίν το Πάσχα, τότε εορτάζει την επόμενη μέρα του Πάσχα (Δευτέρα της Δικαινησίμου)» — a fixed 23 April which is transferred to Bright Monday in a year when it would fall before Pascha. The companions' own pages carry the plain fixed type. The whole body of the page is one sentence: «Ο Άγιος Μάρτυς Αθανάσιος τελειώθηκε διά ξίφους» — he was perfected by the sword. Everything else is in the day's line, which calls him ο από μάγων, and in the couplet, which calls him φαρμακός, a sorcerer, and says that in the cutting off of his head he found a strange medicine for a sick soul. The page places him among the entries of George's day and links to George, but its own text does not say that he confessed at George's martyrdom, as the pages of Anatolius and Protoleon do of them, so no such claim is made here. It gives no year, no country and no judge, and prints no hymn and no relic.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 06.05.2026 (23. април ст. ст.) — „Св. вел. муч. Ђорђе.“

attestations.note: The Prologue's heading for this entry names the great martyr alone, „Св. вел. муч. Ђорђе.“, and the body then names those who received the faith of Christ at his wonders: „Међу овима беше и жена царева Александра, и главни жрец Атанасије, и земљоделац Гликерије, и Валерије, Донат и Терина.“ So this row rests on the entry's enumeration of the company and not on the heading, which does not name him; the quoted line is the heading whole, as BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §4 requires. The Julian 04-21 of this wave set the precedent for a company the body enumerates and the heading does not.
